title: SpiceXplorer per-PDK sizing (design variables)
description: The design knobs (W/L/M) + bounds for one PDK binding (plan §3 tree, pdk/<pdk>/sizing.yaml). Consumed by the optimizer projection and the gm/ID sizing reference.

analysis_params.description: Per-PDK testbench-parameter overrides (assemble.py `_conditions`, highest precedence): key/value pairs that override the shared analyses/<id>.yaml params for THIS binding only — e.g. a different VCM/VDD where the bias window differs between PDKs.

name.description: The symbol used in the netlist (e.g. w_in, x_dut_nfet_input_w).
